title: Rory and the Silver Clover Dale
verses:
The evening was settling over the woods,
The breezes were whispering low,
And Rory walked up to the sweet clover dale,
Where blossoms were starting to glow.

Nia glided down through the shadowy trees,
To rest by a silvery stream,
While Ricky curled up on a warm patch of earth,
And drifted right into a dream.

Then Benny knelt down on the cool clover bed,
A shelter so cozy and wide,
And Psittaco chirped with a delicate yawn,
And nestled right close to his side.

Tilly brought blossoms of purple and blue,
To make them a blanket to share,
Then tucked the soft clover around every friend,
With gentle and tenderest care.

Now Rory curled down in the midst of his friends,
His heavy green tail tucked away,
He looked at the moon as it climbed through the stars,
And waved a goodbye to the day.

The silver dale darkened beneath the soft night,
The crickets hummed melodies deep,
And wrapped in the warmth of the starlight and moss,
The dinosaurs drifted to sleep.
